activities.trigger: Every root-session start, settlement, and explicit work-item closeout records minimal lifecycle facts.
activities.acceptanceRule: Record is private, bounded, schema-valid, and linked to one session and work item.
activities.escalation: Fail closed on invalid local authority; report optional projection gaps.
activities.retirementCondition: Retire only when another local authoritative lifecycle adapter preserves this contract.

activities.trigger: A deterministic correction, failure, or friction signal is present, a successful corrective result opens matched monitoring, or an external backstop requests aggregate review.
activities.method: Assign retrospective or session-to-skill-extractor for bounded learning review, validate settled matched correction cohorts, and revoke applicable grants on confirmed recurrence.
activities.output: One decision receipt and at most one private review assignment
activities.acceptanceRule: Claims are evidence-linked and actionable; incomplete cohorts remain monitoring, and recurrence emits at most one sanitized follow-up.
activities.escalation: Route missing context, repeated recurrence, or consequential intervention to human review.
activities.retirementCondition: Retire when no decision uses its signals or another activity fully owns the learning decision.

activities.source: Repository structure, policy, health, and verified change evidence
activities.trigger: A coherence signal crosses its declared threshold or an external backstop requests review.
activities.method: Assign architecture review, requirement-simplification-review, context-health, or code-simplification for the selected coherence question.
activities.output: One decision receipt and at most one private review assignment
activities.receiver: Assigned architecture, requirement, context-health, or code-simplification reviewer
activities.acceptanceRule: Finding names a current source boundary, evidence, consequence, and bounded intervention.
activities.escalation: Route broad, irreversible, authority-sensitive, or evidence-poor proposals to human review.
activities.retirementCondition: Retire when its signals no longer inform a coherence decision or are absorbed without overlap.

activities.source: Exact model, thinking, tool, action, and accepted-result envelopes
activities.trigger: An exact capability envelope gains evidence, drifts, fails critically, or reaches a review backstop.
activities.method: Apply routing calibration or assign agent-retrospective-loop for bounded capability lifecycle judgment.
activities.output: One decision receipt and at most one private review assignment
activities.acceptanceRule: Conclusion is exact-envelope scoped and cannot grant or widen authority.
activities.escalation: Revert to observe or disabled and route consequential uncertainty to human review.
activities.retirementCondition: Retire when the envelope or decision it calibrates is no longer used.

activities.source: Control-plan activities, receipts, interventions, budgets, and quality metrics
activities.trigger: Coverage, staleness, budget, or intervention evidence requires audit, or a backstop requests review.
activities.method: Audit the quality system against its own invariants and retirement rules.
activities.output: One decision receipt and at most one private review assignment
activities.acceptanceRule: Review identifies retained, changed, or retired controls without creating a competing registry.
activities.escalation: Route missing authority, critical control failure, or plan-wide change to human review.
activities.retirementCondition: Retire only with the governed quality kernel itself and an explicit replacement decision.

metrics.denominator: results with a complete gate verdict
metrics.missingness: Unknown when any gate verdict is absent, incomplete, or lower-bound.
metrics.decision: Keep gate controls or route gate drift to architecture-coherence review.
metrics.cadence: Each settled result and quality-system-review backstop.
metrics.gamingRisk: Selective gate recording can inflate the rate; missing verdicts never count as success.
metrics.retirementCondition: Retire only when a replacement gate-conformance decision metric is approved.

metrics.denominator: results with accepted, verified-pass, rejected, or verified-fail outcomes
metrics.missingness: Unknown or lower-bound outcomes are excluded from success and keep state non-eligible.
metrics.decision: Inform routing and work-learning review; never authorize an effect.
metrics.cadence: Each settled result and cohort review.
metrics.gamingRisk: Unsettled results can be hidden; unknown outcomes remain visible and non-success.
metrics.retirementCondition: Retire when no routing or learning decision uses settled outcome evidence.

metrics.denominator: monitored corrective actions with settled monitoring state
metrics.missingness: Unknown or lower-bound cohorts cannot be treated as non-recurrent.
metrics.decision: Revoke applicable capability and create bounded follow-up when recurrence is confirmed.
metrics.gamingRisk: Premature cohort closure hides recurrence; insufficient samples remain monitoring.
metrics.retirementCondition: Retire when recurrence is governed by a reviewed replacement metric.

metrics.missingness: Unverified or unresolved findings mark the measure lower-bound, not successful.
metrics.decision: Tune reviewer assignment and verification requirements.
metrics.gamingRisk: Dropping unresolved findings inflates precision; unresolved evidence remains lower-bound.
metrics.retirementCondition: Retire when verified finding precision no longer changes reviewer policy.

metrics.denominator: reviewers with a settled calibration result
metrics.missingness: Missing calibration results are unknown and non-eligible.
metrics.decision: Keep, narrow, or route reviewer capability for human review.
metrics.gamingRisk: Only easy calibration cases can overstate capability; exact-envelope scope is retained.
metrics.retirementCondition: Retire when capability decisions use a reviewed replacement calibration measure.

metrics.numerator: review-required results with a settled review
metrics.missingness: Unknown review requirement or incomplete review linkage is non-success.
metrics.decision: Route uncovered consequential work to review or human attention.
metrics.cadence: Each work-item closeout and cohort backstop.
metrics.gamingRisk: Marking work as not requiring review hides coverage gaps; requirement facts stay explicit.
metrics.retirementCondition: Retire when settled review coverage no longer gates any decision.

metrics.missingness: Absent, partial, or lower-bound evidence is not success.
metrics.decision: Keep guards and route evidence gaps before quality conclusions.
metrics.gamingRisk: Reporting only complete artifacts hides loss; missing evidence stays unknown.
metrics.retirementCondition: Retire only when a replacement completeness guard is accepted.

metrics.denominator: all bounded evidence sources checked for privacy
metrics.missingness: Unknown source coverage cannot be reported as zero.
metrics.decision: Any known violation blocks success and routes immediate remediation.
metrics.gamingRisk: Omitting source checks hides violations; this is zero-tolerance and incomplete is unknown.
metrics.retirementCondition: Never retire without an equal-or-stronger zero-tolerance privacy guard.

metrics.denominator: all bounded effect records checked for authority
metrics.missingness: Unknown effect coverage cannot be reported as zero.
metrics.decision: Any known unauthorized mutation blocks success and revokes applicable authority.
metrics.gamingRisk: Unrecorded effects hide violations; incomplete authority evidence is unknown.
metrics.retirementCondition: Never retire without an equal-or-stronger zero-tolerance authority guard.

metrics.missingness: Unknown cost or unconfirmed improvement is excluded from success claims.
metrics.decision: Keep quality work within its declared resource budget or escalate.
metrics.gamingRisk: Unpriced work makes spend appear low; missing cost remains unknown.
metrics.retirementCondition: Retire when resource-budget decisions use a reviewed replacement measure.

metrics.missingness: Missing reviewer class is unknown and non-eligible.
metrics.decision: Balance human attention against risk and uncertainty; never optimize a score.
metrics.gamingRisk: Review class can be mislabeled; provenance remains required.
metrics.retirementCondition: Retire when human-attention routing uses a reviewed replacement measure.

metrics.denominator: corrective actions with validated or recurrent cohorts
metrics.missingness: Monitoring, incomplete, or lower-bound cohorts are not success.
metrics.decision: Retain validated changes; revoke or revisit recurrent changes.
metrics.gamingRisk: Closing monitoring early overstates effectiveness; insufficient samples stay monitoring.
metrics.retirementCondition: Retire when corrective-action decisions use a reviewed replacement measure.
